answer: Every claim climbs the vault of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the atlas re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on ephemeral memory consumption bounds that render bulk automated spawning intractable. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the lagoon of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short.
